articles.title: Ben Affleck Talks to Aflac Duck in new Commercial from Artists Equity
articles.description: Ben Affleck talks to Aflac duck in new commercial spot from Artists Equity on Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade.
articles.content:
Ben Affleck’s Artists Equity and the insurance company Aflac are using Thanksgiving to launch a new installment of their campaign starring the actor and the namesake duck.

articles.title: The Aflac Duck Finally Meets Its Match in Ben Affleck
articles.description: Aflac teamed up with Artists Equity, Affleck and Matt Damon’s production company, for a cinematic ad.
articles.content:
The insurance brand partnered with Artists Equity, the production company founded by Affleck and Matt Damon, on a campaign that plays like a scene from a feature film. Titled “High Stakes,” the ad was directed by and stars Affleck.
